section_summary: This section covers correspondence, applications, and clearance actions between late February and early April 1948 regarding commercial and missionary travel into occupied Japan and Korea. It documents coordination between the Department of State, the Civil Affairs Division of the Department of the Army, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers (SCAP), the Department of Commerce, and foreign embassies regarding entry permits, transit regulations, and strict quota limits due to acute shortages of food and housing. Significant matters include policy restrictions on female travelers, procedures for foreign nationals and stateless persons, and Commerce Department rosters of approved business representatives.
